lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 distinct vertical white lines observed across the lateral torso; spacing is widest between lines 1 and 2, becoming more uniform and compressed across the central ribcage and posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior lines 1 and 2 are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral fringe; posterior line 8 is a partial segment restricted to the upper haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: One high-contrast white spot is visible on the posterior haunch above the knee; no dense clustering of multiple spots is observable in the current orientation.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiraling lyrate geometry; horns diverge laterally from the frontal bone at approximately a 45-degree angle before curving inward and upward toward the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Approximate 2.2:1 ratio between the pixel distance of the terminal tips and the width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 12-15% of the total horn length from tip to base.

other_distinctive_markers: Dorsal crest of long white-tipped hair extending from neck to tail; long, dark ventral fringe; white chevron marking between the eyes; distinctive orange coloration on lower limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints.
